name: 南坡城
description: 南坡城：村庄/城邦占一格，大城最多数格；分区以建筑风格区分，不代表已实现居民、生产或经济。

rules.ground_wall: Only the open authored gate edge permits ground passage for walled sites; villages have no perimeter blocker.
rules.flight: Active flight clears ground-only walls; physical water and air/all blockers still apply.
rules.attack: Binary wall-edge line-of-sight; closed wall/gate blocks authored attacks regardless of weapon or flight. No projectile arc, wall-height simulation or cover bonus.
rules.gate: Unlocked manually operated gate; assessed open/close costs one stamina and one action; no key or social lock invented.
rules.economy: No population, production, ownership or economy simulation.
